### Phase 1 progress: timing instrumentation (baseline-capable)

- Recon (four read-only subagent maps + direct reads) established the actual critical path: per bakeoff round every non-excluded candidate is re-promoted, re-built, re-contrast-audited, re-captured at 3 viewports + authored pages, and re-judged with ~10 high-detail images; the round loop repairs one candidate per round and re-evaluates everything; the visual gate is a separate child process per round. Round dirs `round-00..10` on the #158 acceptance reflect that loop exhausting budgets.
- New `scripts/creative-timing.mjs`: recorder with `record`/`time`, per-category summaries, structured `launchloomTiming` log line. `scripts/report-creative-timings.mjs`: reads a QA `.launchloom` dir (`pipeline-test-report.json` stages, `creative-repair/timing.json`, per-round bakeoff reports, `repair-usage.json`) and can `--compare` two runs with stage/creative/call deltas.
- Wired durations without behavior change: judge + diversity evaluators now return `durationMs`/`attempts` (whole logical call incl. retries); creative repair usage records gain `durationMs`/`attempts`; bakeoff records per-candidate phase timings (`source`, `promote`, `build`, `contrast`, `capture`, `authored-pages`, `judge`) into `candidate.timings` + `report.timings`; orchestrator writes `creative-repair/timing.json` (bakeoff/gate/repair/entries) and flushes it as entries are recorded so failed runs keep the data.
- Tests: `tests/creative-timing.test.ts` (6), `tests/report-creative-timings.test.ts` (3), new assertions in `tests/rendered-creative-repair.test.ts` (54 passed incl. timing.json entries) and `tests/creative-promotion.test.ts` (bakeoff report timings; full suite 22 passed). Also green: creative-repair-loop, creative-judge-runtime, openrouter-cache-integration (142 tests), generation-cost-summary, inference-client, creative-repair-experiment.
- Next: push this instrumentation commit and dispatch the matched BASELINE creative-only run of intake #158 (`inference_provider=opencode-go`) from this exact SHA; then implement phases 2-6 on top while it runs.

### Baseline dispatch + phases 4/5/6/2 landed (same branch)

- Baseline run `38878871977` dispatched from commit `28ed8952` (instrumentation only) at 09:12Z, `creative-only` intake #158, `inference_provider=opencode-go`, QA repo `WrazyAI/llqa-158-creative-38878871977-1`. It pins its own SHA; later commits do not affect it.
- Evidence reuse (plan phase 5): new `scripts/creative-evidence-cache.mjs` stores per-candidate rendered evidence + judge result keyed on a digest of candidate sources, shared site inputs, render settings, judge model, and a version constant. Managed contrast-correction blocks are stripped before hashing so persisted auto-repairs do not invalidate their own evidence; `.launchloom`, candidate dirs, per-round evidence dirs, and the candidate-derived `selected` directory are excluded from the shared digest; evidence with missing files or failed judges is never reused. The orchestrator enables reuse by default (`CREATIVE_EVIDENCE_REUSE=false` kill-switch) and passes `evidence-cache/` into each bakeoff; on a hit the round restores screenshots into its own evidence dir so repair/gate inputs keep working unchanged. Diversity judging is deliberately NOT cached (always re-evaluated), so a changed member can never inherit an old diversity pass.
- Bounded concurrency (plan phase 4): per-candidate judges are scheduled immediately after that candidate's render and overlap the next candidate's render, bounded by `createTaskLimiter` at 2 workers (env `CREATIVE_JUDGE_CONCURRENCY`, clamped 1-3). The candidate loop now has a post-render pass that merges deferred judge results, writes reusable evidence, then scores; models, reasoning, screenshots, viewports, and candidate count are unchanged.
- Progress-aware repairs (plan phase 6): `blockingFindingsSignature` (sha256 of normalized blocking findings) plus a stagnation guard in `run-rendered-creative-repair.mjs` (`MAX_STAGNANT_REPAIRS = 2`). Repairs that leave the blocking set byte-identical twice mark a candidate stagnated; its remaining budget is not spent, other candidates can still be repaired, and the loop fails with an explicit `Stagnation guard:` error instead of repeating equivalent work. Budget-cap tests now vary blocker text to keep exercising the pure budget path; new tests cover the guard and the deferred-judge wiring.
- Template adherence (plan phase 2): new `scripts/design-adherence-guidance.mjs` reads the retained Apache-2.0 frontend-design review copy from `docs/design-guidance/anthropic/frontend-design/SKILL.md` at runtime (no network fetch; provenance pinned in that directory's README) and pairs it with a binding `TEMPLATE_ADHERENCE_CONTRACT` (preserve structure/section order/mechanics/interactions; adapt copy, brand roles, imagery, responsive composition; prohibit generic substitutions, invented facts, trade-dress copying, and boxed contrast fixes). Both blocks now reach the authoring system prompt and the repair prompt's cached reference context.
- Structural drift detection: `reference-contract-compliance.mjs` now reports a critical `section-order` finding when `data-reference-section` values appear out of the assigned sequence (extra local sections are allowed). Verified against the real acceptance-run candidates (`candidate-a/b/c` from `llqa-158-creative-38620904674-1`): all three already conform and produce zero section findings, so this adds drift detection without retroactively failing conforming work.
- Tests so far: creative-evidence-cache (8), task-limiter (2), creative-timing (6), report-creative-timings (3), design-adherence-guidance (3), reference-fidelity incl. two new order tests, creative-repair-loop 135 across three suites, rendered-creative-repair (56 incl. stagnation + kill-switch), creative-promotion reuse test (4 bakeoffs, 29s, only 3 real renders).
